info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Payment By Param1-spec
info.description: The Payment Retrieval API allows users to fetch payment details based on a specific identifier known as param1. This capability is essential for applications requiring real-time access to financial transaction data, enabling users to verify payment statuses or details. Typical consumers of this API include banking applications, financial dashboards, and third-party integrators that need to access payment information efficiently. By leveraging this endpoint, developers can enhance transparency and improve user experiences related to financial transactions.

get.description: Fetches the details of a specific payment execution by its unique identifier. This endpoint allows you to view the status and information associated with the payment execution.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the execution details of a specific payment identified by PAY-300045. The request should include the necessary parameters formatted in JSON to ensure accurate processing.

GetPaymentByParam1Request.description: The request body for the payment execution operation identified by PAY-300045.

paymentId.description: The unique identifier for the payment.

debtorAccountId.description: The account ID of the debtor.

creditorAccountId.description: The account ID of the creditor.

instructedAmount.description: The amount specified for the payment transaction.

requestedExecutionDate.description: The date on which the payment is requested to be executed.

remittanceInformation.description: Information related to the payment, often used for remittance purposes.

paymentRail.description: The payment rail (payment method) used for executing the payment.

chargeBearer.description: Indicates who bears the transaction charge.

purposeCode.description: A code that indicates the purpose of the payment.

recordStatus.description: The status of the payment record.

version.description: The version number of the payment record.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the payment information was last updated.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the payment execution.

GetPaymentByParam1Response_200.description: Schema representing the response for a payment execution request, which includes the details of the payment made.

amount.description: The specific amount to be transferred.

currency.description: The currency in which the amount is specified.

InstructedAmount.description: Schema representing the amount and currency specified for the payment.

responseId.description: The unique identifier for the response generated.

correlationId.description: The correlation ID for tracking the payment request across services.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp at which the metadata was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the payment processing occurs.

Metadata.description: Schema representing additional metadata information regarding the payment execution.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: The unique identifier for the endpoint being accessed. This should match the identifier defined in the API documentation.

X-Runtime-App.description: A string indicating the application responsible for processing the request. This may be useful for tracing requests back to the originating application.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication method, where the client must present a valid JSON Web Token (JWT) for authorization. The JWT must be included in the Authorization header as a Bearer token.
